clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Iron Pike supplies are needed to repair the Everstill Bridge. The shipment from Stormwind was seized by Redridge gnolls, leaving the town short of iron.

Lakeshire spent its metal reserves forging armor, blades, and ammunition after recent attacks by the Blackrock orcs. Builders requested more iron from Stormwind City, but Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan on the road. They carried crates of iron pikes and rivets north into the hills, stopping repairs on the Everstill Bridge.

Foreman Oslow oversees the bridge's reconstruction and needs the stolen hardware back. Without the heavy pikes to reinforce its stone and timber frame, the bridge leaves Lakeshire partly cut off from the northern road and open to further incursions.
